subject.title: Feature request: Coalesce interleaved text blocks into single outbound message

question: Should OpenClaw add a core opt-in policy that coalesces or defers assistant text across tool execution into one outbound message per turn, and what config shape should own it?
rationale: The source-backed UX problem is real, but the fix adds channel delivery policy and likely configuration surface across shared agent/channel paths, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Add opt-in coalescing policy
options.body: Define a narrow agents/channel delivery mode that preserves metadata and coalesces text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.

options.title: Keep current delivery boundaries
options.body: Preserve pre-tool and per-block message boundaries and document existing streaming/coalescing controls as the supported behavior.

options.title: Split through broader delivery policy
options.body: Resolve this together with the open suppression and Discord ordering trackers before adding a new mode.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in coalescing policy
recommendation.body: Define a narrow agents/channel delivery mode that preserves metadata and coalesces text across tool execution with tests for streamed and final payload paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal across the coalescer, embedded runner, and reply delivery paths involved in the product decision.
